How I Became a White Supremacist

Races, genders, creeds. We like to imagine them as equal but life doesn't really care what we would prefer, not everyone is equal in every way. Woman are not as physically strong as men, men cannot take as much pain as a woman, a white person will make more logical leaps than a black person, a black person retain loyalty easier than a white person.

In a thousand subtle ways, some meaninful and some not so much, the physical and subsurface realities of humanity tell a simple story of minumums and maximums with context telling us the actual values. Does this mean that black people are inherently dumber than white people? No, it depends on the individual. Does that mean that the smartest white person will be smarter than the smartest black person? Perhaps, intelligence is a complex metric.

Does any of this mean we should have different laws for individuals? No. Does this mean we should not mix the races? No.

Humanity got this far because we were adaptive, not because we the strongest at every stage, or the smartest at every stage or the longest lived. We got here by being able to adapt and nothing more. If you find your world view is fixed then you have already been left behind, and if you are reaching for physical perfection in a race of humans then you are drastically misunderstanding the value of humanity. What is strong today is weakness tomorrow, change is the only constant.
